input.summary: Ported scan.cu to scan.cpp in plain SYCL 2020. It uses 1-D nd_range kernels, local_accessor, sycl::group_barrier and USM, with no dpct headers, helpers or macros. It compiled cleanly with add_dpct_include=false. I did not run the binary or compare its output against the reference, so exact correctness is unverified. I added two group barriers that the CUDA kernels lack: one in the plain scan before the write-back, and one at the end of each grid-stride iteration. They protect the local buffer between iterations and should not change the results.
